title: Bone Idol
wikitext:
{{disambig}} [[Bone Idol]]s come in two distinct appearances: * '''[[Bone Idol (hooked)|Hooked]]''': The generic skin. Available as drop, from [[weaponsmith]]s, or from [[collector]]s in in all campaigns except Prophecies. ** It is also the skin available to all PvP characters [[PvP Bone Idol|as focus item]] tied to [[Soul Reaping]]. * '''[[Bone Idol (horned skull)|Horned skull]]''': The rare skin exclusively found as drop in all campaigns. ** A [[Bone Idol (promotional)|promotional version]] with predetermined stats tied to multiple [[Necromancer]] attributes, only accessible through an access key for pre-orders of [[Guild Wars Prophecies]] purchased from [[w:CompUSA|CompUSA]] in North America.
